beschreibung: VfB Stuttgart head into crucial Bundesliga encounter without leading league goalscorer – VfB Stuttgart head coach Sebastian Hoeneß faces another injury setback ahead of Friday's Bundesliga encounter with Borussia Mönchengladbach.

RB Leipzig’s Christoph Baumgartner marks emotional comeback and reunion with Yan Diomande – Christoph Baumgartner marked his return from a four-month injury layoff with an assist against Real Madrid on Wednesday evening, fittingly placing his name on the scoresheet alongside a former teammate whom he's always held in high regard.
